title: Frost Probe Sunrise Alert
app: WeatherFlow Tempest, Ecowitt, PurpleAir, AirGradient, ESPHome plant sensors, aquarium controllers, and pollen feeds streamed to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=plant:sensor sensor_type=frost
| eval hour=tonumber(strftime(_time,"%H"))
| where hour>=3 AND hour<=7
| bin _time span=1d
| stats min(temp_c) as min_temp_c by zone _time
| where min_temp_c<1
| sort min_temp_c
description: Uses Outdoor frost probes telemetry to monitor the coldest pre-dawn temperature in each growing zone in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for frost-risk mornings before they damage plants, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Outdoor frost probes data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a daily cadence.
grandmaExplanation: It lists the coldest pre-dawn temperature in each growing zone so you can spot frost-risk mornings before they damage plants before it becomes annoying.
